summary: folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: folder-lint@1.0.19 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts the Bun binary, chmod +x on Unix, and execFileSync's the sibling file math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header) obfuscated with string-array rotation and a custom-alphabet base64 decoder; identifiers are mangled and no source or sourcemap is shipped. The package is advertised as a folder-lint library, which has no need for an alternate language runtime or an opaque compiled payload. The Bun runtime and the obfuscated bundle are pulled in and executed automatically on npm install, before any consumer code runs; the executed bytes are not Node-inspected and are hidden behind a misleading math_init.js filename.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
